# Event producer and consumer matrix (generated)

Event types named in backticks in the ADRs, recognised by the event forms of the glossary's verb list (ADR-0004 rule 22), or by a final word in -ed. The producer module is the stated owner of the table the event's noun names (the noun of `<Noun><event form>`); `—` means no DDL table has that name. Consumers are the consumer names (`consumer \`x\``, `\`x\` consumer`) written on the same ADR line as the event. This is text extraction, not the registry: the registry's declarations (ADR-0013 rule 6; ADR-0058 rule 4 note in ADR-0008 rule 1) replace it at build step 0.
